display_name: 任务指导的可微盲信道后验源域原型
description: 固定地面基座和源条件先验，通过可微高斯后验联合优化盲信道估计，使用源干净 IQ 和冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 特征指导。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 one source-only training process, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled, full-loss zero-gradient source smoke required

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ float32 [2,256], source simulation action/noise labels for physics loss, conditional prior posterior and frozen F features; inference receives IQ only
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels, U_s truth, V or test read; F clean pseudo targets for source evaluation
data.validation_ref: 384 RX8 source heldout IDs, 64 per scene, same previously observed pilot cohort; no checkpoint selection
data.leo_config_ref: Source cache epoch20 training, epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Source training and source holdout only, no V or test IQ
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed source feasibility, previously observed source IDs, no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed pretrained blind action estimator, source Gaussian prior and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; only blind estimator weights updated; DURA loaded after updates for source comparator.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed pass over 4096 train IDs, final checkpoint only; report same 384 source RX8 records with no selection and no target access.

execution.launch_owner: Codex differentiable posterior pilot GPU2 owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 only; source-only training and prediction, no TF32, independent resource preflight

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Frozen F pseudo targets not truth; source samples previously observed; DURA source comparator only; no target predictions.

rows.method: differentiate conditional Gaussian posterior through blind action estimate and fixed ground F, regularize physics and paired IQ
rows.purpose: test whether downstream-aware blind channel updates improve restoration before full source selection
rows.seed_notes: fixed prior and RX8 same as parent; fit subset and order seed2026120555
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 4096 train source IDs, batch8 one pass, fixed 8192 source prior IDs, 384 source RX8 heldout
